subject: shiny 0.9.1 - error in arguments of shinyServer

messages.author: d4b814fe2ccd924a
messages.subject: shiny 0.9.1 - error in arguments of shinyServer
parts:
Hello Shiny developers,
I'm trying to run an application that used to work in shiny0.8.0 using a version I downloaded from git this Monday (April 28); see sessionInfo() output below.

The error seems to occur in server.R right at shinyServer() function declaration; print statements just before shinyServer() call get printed to R console, but those right inside shinyServer() do not.
This is the error message:
Error in (structure(function (x, y)  :
  unused arguments (input = list(impl = <S4 object of class "ReactiveValues">), output = list(impl = <S4 object of class "ShinySession">))

The overall structure of shinyServer() function is as follows:
shinyServer(function(input,output) {
 myout <- reactive({...load data here...})
 out$scatplot <- renderPlot({ myOut <- myout();  code_related_to_making_plot1 })
out$other_plot <- renderPlot({ myOut <- myout(); code_related_to_making_plot2 })
...
out$var1 <- renderUI{ ...}
})

Here is the output of sessionInfo()

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: shiny 0.9.1 - error in arguments of shinyServer
parts:
Thanks for the report, Shraddha. I noticed this recently too and thought I had done something silly. Now that I look at it some more, I think it is a bug in the latest version of Shiny. I opened a ticket for it here so you can follow the progress, if you'd like. Note that this bug is not present in the version of Shiny that's out on CRAN now, so you can remedy this by just installing that version:

install.packages("shiny")

Jeff
